title: Split a line across accounts
summary: How to share one bank line across several accounts, such as one shop receipt for office supplies and tools.

steps.text: In To review, click Split under the line's account box. Or select the line and press S.
For each part, type the account, choose the GST code and type the amount. Amounts include GST, the way they are on the receipt.

image.description: The Split sheet for OFFICEWORKS 0412, $236.45. Two lines: Office supplies with GST, $86.45, and Tools and small equipment with GST, $150.00. Left to split says $0.00 with a tick. Add line, Cancel and Save split are below.

steps.text: Click Add line if you need more parts. Left to split shows what is still to share out.
When Left to split says $0.00 with a tick, click Save split. The line is posted, with the GST worked out on each part.

sections.heading: If something goes wrong
paragraphs: Save split stays grey: the parts do not add up to the line yet, or a part has no account. Left to split says how much is left, or how much too much.
You split it wrongly: click Undo in the message at the top, or press Command and Z, and split it again.
